papers.title_en: Constraints on recovering quantum information after erasure
papers.authors: Mohammad A. Alhejji, Noah Lordi, Omkar Baraskar, Ariel Shlosberg, Emanuel Knill
papers.evidence: 擦除后量子信息恢复的约束
papers.tldr: 量子信息编码在n个物理载体上，擦除信道下每个载体以概率t被擦除，Hastings猜想当t≥1/2时无法以超过1-t的概率完美恢复信息且错误渐近为零。本研究通过建立新的量子不可克隆约束，严格证明了该猜想，确立了恢复概率的上界。这一结果为量子擦除信道的纠错码设计和容量研究提供了根本性理论限制。
papers.abstract_en: Suppose that we encode quantum information into $ n $ physical carriers. With what probabilities can we perfectly recover the quantum information after sets of carriers have been erased? This question arises in the study of quantum erasure channels, for which M.B. Hastings conjectured that if each carrier is independently erased with probability $ t \geq 1/2 $, then it is impossible to recover the quantum information with asymptotically vanishing error and probability $ > 1-t $. We prove this conjecture by establishing new no-cloning constraints on realizable recovery probabilities.
